blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Newly appointed Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Secretary Lino Cayetano on Tuesday said his political differences with his siblings will not hinder their family from serving Filipinos. He also called on supporters of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to unite across political lines and focus on programs that will benefit Filipinos, saying shared values matter more than party affiliations. Cayetano made the appeal when asked about his political differences with two of his elder siblings, Senators Alan Peter and Pia Cayetano, who are identified to be politically allied with Vice President Sara Duterte. “For me, it doesn’t change anything.
